title: Reader Chapter 5
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

breakdown.fullRead: That is why the Framingham findings are useful and risky at the same time. Nicholas Christakis and James Fowler reported that obesity clustered in the Framingham Heart Study network. That claim is debated, so do not read it as proof that body size jumps from mind to mind. A careful reading says your standards can shift when the people close to you act as if a behavior is ordinary.
